name: @seorilabs/babycare
description: 여러 양육자가 실시간으로 함께 쓰는 아기 돌봄 기록 앱

scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:mobile && pnpm run test:firebase && pnpm run test:functions && pnpm run test:functions:emulator && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:docs
scripts.test:static: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:mobile && pnpm run test:functions && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:docs
scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --project babycare-rules-test --only firestore,storage "node --test --test-concurrency=1 firebase/tests/security-rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:functions:emulator: pnpm --dir firebase/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.functions-test.json --project babycare-functions-test --only firestore "pnpm --dir firebase/functions test:emulator"
